full_judgment:
7. On behalf of the appellants it is argued that the right of redemption was lost under section 266 of the Bengal Tenancy Act, no step having been taken within 3 years after the expiry of the period of mortgage. 

 8. The learned Judge of the High Court Division found that the admitted position was that 1.60 acres of land was mortgaged by Abdul Hamid to the defendants' predecessors, Badiuddin and Nazu Mia, by executing two mortgage deeds, Exts, B and BI, on 16-6-1919 for a period of 5 years. The learned Judge then found that the plaintiff or his predecessor-in-interest Abdul Hamid was at liberty to file a regular suit for possession and redemption instead of taking recourse to section 266 of the Bengal Tenancy Act for the said purpose. The learned Judge observed that the present suit was filed by the plaintiff who is an heir of the mortgagor Abdul Hamid for declaration of his title and confirmation of possession, in the alternative, for recovery possession and "there is no bar against treating this suit for redemption of the mortgage entered into by Abdul Hamid." The learned Judge then went on to consider whether the suit was filed within the period of limitation i.e. 60 years under article 148 of the Limitation Act. The mortgages were for 5 years i.e. from 16-6-1919 and, as such, the learned Judge found that they were extinguished after the expiry of 15-6-1924 and consequently the cause of action for a suit for redemption or for recovery of Khas possession of the lands under Exts. B and BI accrued on 16-6-1924. The present suit having been filed on 8-12-82, it was well within 60 years from the date of accrual of the cause of action and as such the suit was not barred by limitation, the learned Judge held. 

 9. The learned Judge then observed that since by operation of sub-section (5) of section 266 of the Bengal Tenancy Act the mortgage of 1.60 acres of land by Abdul Hamid in favor of the predecessors-in-interest of the contesting defendants under the deeds of mortgage Exts. B and B(1) had been extinguished and the suit was not barred by limitation and being within time, the plaintiff is entitled to redeem the said mortgages and get khas possession of the said land.
